scientific_integrity: All-order claim is supported by a complete symbolic proof; finite computations are independently repeatable, not substituted for infinite proof. Source publication and archive eligibility use the first publicly available 2015-03-12 preprint, rather than later journal publication.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on the existence of finite affine planes of order at least three and assumes unit-edge shortest-path metrics and inclusive filtration scales. The executable corroboration exhaustively treats only prime orders two and three; the general proof uses incidence axioms and homotopy pushouts. Historical originality remains subject to possible unindexed prior work.
title: Affine-plane incidence Rips complexes have two sphere dimensions
